records.title: FDA ESG still cannot deliver a conformant message or record FDA's acknowledgments: no S/MIME AS2, no MDN verification, no ACK1-3 ingestion, no center routing; SFTP dependency still absent
records.evidenceAtHead: server/services/submission-gateways/fda-esg.ts:18-35 still declares the gap: the AS2 envelope is not PKCS#7/CMS S/MIME, the MDN is not verified, and checkStatus does not poll. fda-esg.ts:734-741 posts contentType 'application/octet-stream' with a detached signAs2Body signature (as2-transport.ts:486; as2-transport.ts:14-25 repeats the gap). fda-esg.ts:768 marks the row 'received' on a 2xx accepting MDN whose signature and MIC are not verified. fda-esg.ts:290-310 transmitViaNextGenRest still throws UnverifiedTransportError. fda-esg.ts:568-593: SFTP still dynamically imports ssh2-sftp-client, and `grep ssh2 package.json` returns nothing. fda-esg.ts:782-805: checkStatus returns the stored row (source 'stored'). server/services/ectd/filed-sequence-rejection.ts:13 says 'There is no Ack3 ingestion'. The only mutating transmittal routes are rollback, technical-rejection and findings (server/routes/mdx-submission-gateway.ts:453,532,592). `grep -n 'CDER|CBER|CDRH' server/services/submission-gateways/*.ts` matches only a comment (fda-esg.ts:81), so there is no center routing. Honesty changes since the audit: transport-refusals.ts:21 FDA_ESG_NOT_PROVEN and market-support.ts:282 label FDA ESG 'unproven'; pmda-gateway.ts:68 and health-canada-gateway.ts refuse; ema-cesp.ts:332 refuses centralised filings. The MHRA, NMPA, TGA, Swissmedic, ANVISA, CDSCO, MFDS, HSA and EUDAMED adapters still POST to unsourced endpoints when credentials exist (e.g. mhra-gateway.ts:86), with no UnverifiedTransportError guard. UI: GatewayTransmittals.tsx:494 shows a 412 'gateway credentials are not configured'.
records.remaining: Everything in the original impact. (1) The AS2 message is not S/MIME: not signed as multipart/signed and not enveloped as application/pkcs7-mime. (2) The MDN signature, Received-Content-MIC and Original-Message-ID are not verified before 'received'. (3) ACK1/ACK2/ACK3 are not ingested: there is no inbound AS2 receiver or SFTP /outgoing/ poller, checkStatus is a stored-row echo, and ectd_sequences.dispatch_status never reaches 'acknowledged' from an agency ack. (4) There is no CDER/CBER/CDRH routing metadata. (5) ssh2-sftp-client is not in package.json, so bundles over 1 GB are refused. (6) The ESG NextGen REST path is unverified and refuses. (7) No test sequence has been accepted in FDA's ESG test environment. (8) Nine non-FDA adapters still post to unsourced endpoints if credentials are configured. This is outside the FDA-only pilot, but they lack the typed pre-wire refusal.
records.severityRationale: The launch catalog names 'Submission Center (eCTD v3.2.2 + FDA ESG)', and launch row D7 requires one test sequence accepted by FDA's test environment with the ack chain filed. In-product transmission to FDA cannot work at all: a configured AS2 send would be rejected for its envelope, and nothing ingests the ACKs. This is a core launch journey that cannot work, so P0 under the scale. It is not a safety exposure, because the code fails closed (typed refusals, 412, 'unproven' labels). A founder-supported pilot could export the zip and upload it through FDA's own ESG web submission, but that is a workaround outside the product.
records.humanTestingNote: On any local or staging deployment without FDA ESG credentials, Transmit in Gateway Transmittals or the sequence Dispatch tab ends with a toast: 'Not transmitted — gateway credentials are not configured for this environment' (HTTP 412). The gateway table shows FDA ESG as 'not configured'. No acknowledgment beyond the stored row ever appears. Workaround: test through assemble, dispatch-readiness and package download; mark transmit and acknowledgment as out of scope for this round. Do not put real FDA production ESG credentials on staging: a send would go to FDA in a non-conformant envelope.
records.instructions:
1. FOUNDER: decide the transport and record the decision in docs/decisions/. Options: (a) build AS2 S/MIME in-house; (b) the ESG NextGen API; (c) a certified ESG transmission partner. Obtain an FDA ESG TEST (pre-production) account, the AS2 identifier and a certificate for the pilot sponsor (client mode, gateway-accounts.ts) or for the platform as transmission agent. Without this, steps 9-10 cannot run; report BLOCKED rather than done.
2. Option (a): add a pinned CMS library to package.json at an exact version (e.g. pkijs + asn1js, or node-forge). In server/services/submission-gateways/as2-transport.ts, add `buildSmimeAs2Message({ body, filename, signerCertPem, signerKeyPem, recipientCertPem })`. It returns { headers, wireBody, mic }: (i) a MIME entity application/octet-stream with Content-Disposition filename; (ii) multipart/signed; protocol=application/pkcs7-signature; micalg=sha-256, with a detached SHA-256 CMS signature by the sponsor key; (iii) application/pkcs7-mime; smime-type=enveloped-data, encrypted to recipientCertPem (FDA's certificate) with the content-encryption algorithm in FDA's current ESG AS2 guide; (iv) the base64 SHA-256 MIC of the signed entity. Delete signAs2Body once nothing calls it (it is also used by ind-lifecycle/icsr-gateway-transport.ts; migrate that caller in the same change, per zero duplication).
3. In fda-esg.ts:732-748, replace the buildAs2Headers({ contentType: 'application/octet-stream', signaturePem: signAs2Body(...) }) call with buildSmimeAs2Message. Post the enveloped wireBody, and set Disposition-Notification-Options (as2-transport.ts:477) to signed-receipt-protocol=required, pkcs7-signature; signed-receipt-micalg=required, sha-256. Keep the mic for step 4.
4. In as2-transport.ts parseMdn (:317) and classifyAs2Delivery (:929), return RECEIVED only when all of the following hold: the MDN is multipart/signed; its CMS signature verifies against fdaCertPem; Received-Content-MIC equals the computed mic; Original-Message-ID equals our messageId; the disposition is 'processed'. An unsigned MDN, a MIC mismatch or a signature failure becomes DELIVERED_UNCONFIRMED ('in_transit', inside the lock), never 'received'.
5. Add the FDA routing metadata. Derive the center (CDER/CBER/CDRH) and the ESG submission type from the application type and the program record, never from a default. Refuse pre-wire (ValidationError with NOTHING_TRANSMITTED) when it cannot be derived. Send it in the AS2 header attributes that FDA's current ESG User Guide specifies; cite the guide section in a code comment.
6. ACK ingestion. (i) Create table submission_transmittal_acks in a new migration appended before the final RLS sweep pair (ci:migration-set-order): public schema, organization_id INTEGER NOT NULL, transmittal_id, ack_kind ('ack1','ack2','ack3'), core_id, raw bytea, raw_sha256, received_at. (ii) Add an inbound AS2 receiver route, e.g. POST /api/as2/inbound in a new server/routes/as2-inbound.ts, unauthenticated by session but authenticated by the FDA certificate. It verifies the FDA signature, decrypts with the sponsor key (platform or client account), parses the ACK, matches it to submission_transmittals by Message-ID or core id, stores the raw bytes verbatim, and moves the status to ack1_received / ack2_received / ack3_received / validation_failed. (iii) Propagate the new status to ectd_sequences.dispatch_status via toDispatchStatus (server/services/submission-service/submission-service.ts:1766). (iv) Rewrite FdaEsgGateway.checkStatus (fda-esg.ts:782-805) and downloadAcknowledgment (:807) to read the latest stored ack, with provenance 'agency'.
7. Add ssh2-sftp-client at an exact version to package.json, plus a test that drives transmitViaSftp (fda-esg.ts:556-612) against a local SFTP fixture. Alternatively, if the founder de-scopes bundles over 1 GB, keep the typed refusal and say so in FDA_ESG_NOT_PROVEN.
8. For mhra, nmpa, tga-ebs, swissmedic, anvisa, cdsco-sugam, mfds, hsa-prism and ema:eudamed: make transmit() throw UnverifiedTransportError(..., ADAPTER_UNSOURCED) before insertTransmittal and before any request, mirroring pmda-gateway.ts:68. Add one failing-first test per adapter asserting that no request and no row are made.
9. Verify every gate by making it fail first: write the MDN-verification tests (wrong MIC, unsigned MDN, wrong signer) and show them failing against HEAD's classifier before the change.
10. Run scripts/fda-esg-uat-smoke.ts against FDA's ESG test environment with a DTD-valid sequence (needs CAT2-01 to CAT2-04). File ACK1-3 verbatim under docs/evidence/D7/. Only then change transport-refusals.ts:21 FDA_ESG_NOT_PROVEN and market-support.ts:282, and the fda-esg.ts and as2-transport.ts header gap notes.
11. All commits go on concept2cure-v2 (Rule 0), merging and never rebasing.
records.acceptance: (a) A new unit test fails against HEAD and passes after the change. It decrypts the wire body of an FDA ESG transmit with a test FDA key using `openssl smime -decrypt` (or the CMS library), verifies the inner multipart/signed signature with the sponsor test certificate, and asserts the Content-Type is application/pkcs7-mime. (b) classifyAs2Delivery returns non-RECEIVED for an unsigned MDN, a MIC mismatch and a wrong signer; each case is shown failing first. (c) An inbound ACK2/ACK3 fixture posted to the receiver stores the raw bytes in submission_transmittal_acks, moves submission_transmittals.status to ack3_received, and sets ectd_sequences.dispatch_status='acknowledged'. A forged (unsigned) ACK is refused and stores nothing. (d) A transmit with no derivable center is refused pre-wire with NOTHING_TRANSMITTED. (e) Each non-FDA adapter's transmit throws UnverifiedTransportError with no HTTP request and no row. (f) docs/evidence/D7 holds ACK1-3 from FDA's ESG test environment for one test sequence, and the sequence status was moved by them.
records.dependencies: Founder: FDA ESG test and production accounts, AS2 identifier, certificates, and the transport/partner decision. CAT2-01 (DTDs), CAT2-02/03/04 (Module 1, ICH tree, STF) for FDA to accept a test sequence. CAT2-09 (one transmit spine), so the ACKs update the sequence the UI transmits. CAT2-06 for whose key decrypts inbound ACKs.

records.title: Per-organisation FDA ESG client accounts now exist (encrypted, admin + re-auth, RLS), but the platform account is the silent default, isConfigured still writes credential rows, and key custody is one env key with no KMS or rotation
records.evidenceAtHead: New: server/services/submission-gateways/gateway-accounts.ts. GATEWAY_ACCOUNT_SPECS has fda:esg with clientTransmit:true and fields clientCertPem/clientKeyPem; every other gateway is record-only. resolveGatewayAccount returns platform when there is no row. fda-esg.ts:133-173: credentialsFor/loadFdaClientCredentials send under the org's own AS2 id, cert and key. index.ts:244-262: the guarded transmit resolves the account, refuses an unusable client account before the wire (clientAccountRefusal), and stamps mode and senderIdentifier on the transmittal. migrations/20261001g_organization_gateway_accounts.sql: public schema, organization_id INTEGER NOT NULL, registered at scripts/db/migration-set.mjs:3078. server/routes/gateway-accounts.ts:107-119: PUT requires admin/owner plus verifyReauth and writes a chained audit row. Ciphertext comes from server/services/security/credential-cipher.ts: AES-256-GCM under a key scrypt-derived from the single env CONNECTOR_ENCRYPTION_KEY with a static salt 'salt'. There is no key id or version, no rotation, no KMS, and the key is shared with the connector registry. Still present: fda-esg.ts:197-210, inside loadFdaCredentials, runs `void pool.query(INSERT INTO submission_gateway_credentials ... VALUES (orgId,'fda','esg',env,'mtls', as2From, certPath, 'active'))`. That function is reached from isConfigured (fda-esg.ts:631-647), and GET /api/gateway-accounts calls isConfigured for every org (gateway-accounts.ts route lines 52-54). Platform certs and keys are still PEM files read from FDA_ESG_*_PATH (fda-esg.ts:175-229). No letter of authorization or transmission-agent record is checked before a platform-mode transmit.
records.fixedBy: b7bf25037, cb2ec9bad, df19950d7 — server/services/submission-gateways/gateway-accounts.ts; fda-esg.ts:133-173; index.ts:244-262; server/routes/gateway-accounts.ts; migrations/20261001g_organization_gateway_accounts.sql; client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/GatewayAccountsSetting.tsx
records.remaining: (1) The side-effect INSERT in loadFdaCredentials (fda-esg.ts:197-210) still runs from isConfigured and the read-only GET. Merely viewing settings records the platform's AS2 identity and cert path as that organisation's 'active' credential, and the insert uses the RLS-bypassing global pool. (2) No KMS or secrets-manager custody: one static-salt env key with no key versioning or rotation path for organization_gateway_accounts.credentials_ciphertext. Platform private keys are PEM files on disk. (3) No row means platform mode. No explicit per-org choice and no recorded transmission-agent authorization (LoA) are required before sending under the platform's identity. (4) Client mode carries no SFTP key, so bundles over 1 GB cannot go under a client account (refused, which is acceptable).
records.severityRationale: The pilot is one invited org. It can be given its own encrypted client account (admin plus re-auth, RLS-isolated), or the founder can choose platform-as-agent deliberately. Transmission does not work yet anyway (CAT2-05). What remains is key custody (KMS, rotation) and audit hygiene (a misleading credential row), which are enterprise-GA items. It rises to P1 if the pilot sends under the platform account without a sponsor-signed transmission-agent LoA on file with FDA.
records.humanTestingNote: Settings → Agency gateway accounts works: choosing 'client' for FDA ESG asks for the AS2 id, certificate and key, and other gateways show client mode as not supported. Testers will not observe the side-effect row or the key-custody gap. If the staging env has FDA_ESG_* set, opening that page writes submission_gateway_credentials rows; this is harmless for testing but misleading in the audit export.
records.instructions:
1. Remove the side-effect write. Delete the `void pool.query(INSERT INTO submission_gateway_credentials ...)` block in loadFdaCredentials (fda-esg.ts:195-210). Record the identity at send time instead: in FdaEsgGateway.transmit, after credentialsFor (fda-esg.ts:~668), add to the transmittal metadata the sending AS2 id and the SHA-256 fingerprint of the client certificate DER, never the path. index.ts:260 already stamps mode/senderIdentifier, so extend that object instead of adding a second record. Leave the submission_gateway_credentials table: mdx-health.service.ts:155 requires it, and removing it would need an in-place amendment of its creating migration (Rule 1).
2. Write the failing-first test in server/services/submission-gateways/__tests__/fda-esg-client-account.test.ts (or a new file). Set full FDA_ESG_STAGING_* env pointing at temp PEM files, spy on pool.query, call getGatewayUnguarded('fda','esg').isConfigured(1,'staging'), and assert that no INSERT is issued. Show it failing at HEAD, then passing.
3. Key custody. Add server/services/security/kms-envelope.ts. On encrypt, it calls AWS KMS GenerateDataKey (key id from CREDENTIAL_KMS_KEY_ID) and stores 'kms1:<keyId>:<b64 encDataKey>:<iv>:<tag>:<ct>'. On decrypt, it reads that format via KMS Decrypt and falls back to the legacy 'iv:tag:ct' format through credential-cipher.decryptCredential. Use it in gateway-accounts.ts writeGatewayAccount and resolveGatewayAccount. In production, refuse to boot without CREDENTIAL_KMS_KEY_ID: add an assert beside assertRlsEnforcementForProduction() at server/config/environment.ts:294, plus a deploy-aws.yml preflight check next to the RLS_ENFORCE check (~line 514).
4. Add scripts/ops/rotate-gateway-credentials.mjs. It re-encrypts every organization_gateway_accounts.credentials_ciphertext under the current KMS key inside one transaction per org, run as the runtime role so RLS applies, and writes a chained audit row per org.
5. Platform private keys: load FDA_ESG_*_CERT/KEY from AWS Secrets Manager ARNs (FDA_ESG_CERT_SECRET_ARN etc.) instead of file paths in loadFdaCredentials. Keep the path variables only outside production.
6. FOUNDER decision, then code. If the platform acts as transmission agent, require an explicit organization_gateway_accounts row with account_mode='platform' plus a Vault document id for the sponsor's authorization before a production platform-mode transmit. Add a nullable column agent_authorization_document_id with a new additive ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS migration placed before the final RLS sweep pair. In the guard (index.ts:247-251), throw CredentialError pre-wire when it is missing. Verify that test fails first.
7. Commit on concept2cure-v2 only (Rule 0).
records.acceptance: (a) The isConfigured no-INSERT test fails at HEAD and passes after. (b) A production-mode environment test without CREDENTIAL_KMS_KEY_ID throws at config load. (c) A round-trip test proves legacy ciphertext still decrypts and new writes carry the kms1: prefix with a KMS mock. (d) The rotation script re-encrypts and resolveGatewayAccount still returns identical credentials. (e) If step 6 is adopted, a production platform-mode transmit without an authorization document is refused with CredentialError, and refusedBeforeWire() is true.
records.dependencies: CAT2-05: this only matters once transmission is real. AWS KMS key and IAM grant on the production task role (founder/infra). Founder decision on platform-as-transmission-agent and LoA.

records.title: Sequences filed outside the platform still cannot be imported, so replace, append and delete against an existing application are impossible
records.evidenceAtHead: server/services/ectd/package-sequence-lifecycle.ts:17-19: 'the history is appended at successful transmit, never at assembly'. planSequence (:430, :503-531) refuses with NO_PRIOR_SEQUENCE ('File sequence 0000 first') or SEQUENCE_OUT_OF_ORDER, whose text ends 'If a sequence was filed outside this system, its record has to reach this package before a follow-up can be built on it.' No code path supplies that record. On the sequence spine, server/services/ectd/prior-sequence-loader.ts:138-205 loadLatestPriorManifestBySubmission reads only ectd_compilations joined to ectd_sequences with dispatch_status IN ('sent','acknowledged'). That status is set only by toDispatchStatus after a gateway transmit (submission-service.ts:1760-1769). Per package-from-core.ts:266-273, without a prior manifest a declared replace, append or delete is refused or skipped. server/services/legacy-importer/detector.ts is unchanged since 92ccdba1. Its consumer, server/routes/mdx-imports.ts:282-420 (approve), only creates concept2cure_artifacts rows with content '' and writes no filed-sequence manifest, leaf IDs or lifecycle history. `grep -rni 'filed_externally|externally.filed|outside this system' server shared` matches only the refusal text above. Commit d5176f241 (P-14) anchors a submission to a project and is not an import.
records.remaining: The whole capability is missing. Nothing parses an archived sequence (index.xml, index-md5.txt, m1/us/us-regional.xml, STF) into SequenceLeafManifestEntry records with leafId/backbone (server/services/ectd/sequence-manifest.ts:26-60). Nothing records imported sequences as filed on the ectd_sequences/ectd_compilations spine or in submission_packages.metadata.filedSequences. There is no governed (signed) import act and no UI.
records.severityRationale: The code fails closed: it refuses or skips rather than misfiling, so there is no integrity exposure. A pilot can start on a new application (0000) or with new-only leaves. A small US biotech design partner very likely has an IND filed by another publisher, though, and an IND amendment that replaces an IB or protocol is routine. That makes this must-fix before pilot users rely on the product for their existing application. It is P0 if the pilot's first in-product filing is such a follow-up.
records.humanTestingNote: Testers cannot exercise replace, append or delete at all. There is no import, and in-system filed history accrues only after a successful gateway transmit, which CAT2-05 prevents on test deployments. Symptom on the sequence spine: assembling 0001+ with a leaf declared 'replace' reports it skipped ('declared replace: no filed leaf named ... to supersede ...'), which blocks transmit. On the package path: 409 NO_PRIOR_SEQUENCE ('File sequence 0000 first'). Workaround: test 0000 originals and new-only follow-ups; cover lifecycle operations by unit tests only for this round.
records.instructions:
1. Add server/services/ectd/legacy-sequence-import.ts with parseFiledSequence(archive). Accept one sequence folder or zip (use the repo's jszip/adm-zip; refuse path traversal and symlinks using bundle-leaf-security.ts rules). Verify index-md5.txt equals md5(index.xml). Parse index.xml and m1/us/us-regional.xml with @xmldom/xmldom (package.json:536), with external entity and DTD resolution disabled. For every <leaf>, emit a SequenceLeafManifestEntry (sequence-manifest.ts:26) carrying ID→leafId, the backbone path, xlink:href→href, operation, checksum→md5, modified-file, title, and ctdSection from the enclosing heading element. Add a reverse map next to ectd-packager/ich-headings.ts and fda-regional-sections.ts; never guess a section, and refuse unmapped headings with the element name. Verify each leaf file's MD5 against its bytes. From us-regional.xml, read the application number, sequence number, submission type and sub-type codes, and submission-id.
2. Add the governed act importFiledSequences in server/services/ectd/filed-sequence-import.ts, modelled on filed-sequence-rejection.ts. Inputs: orgId, submissionId, the Vault document ids holding each archived sequence (uploaded through Vault ingest), reason, meaning, and verified re-auth. In ONE transaction: read each Vault document FOR SHARE; parse; refuse unless the sequences are consecutive from 0000, or from a declared baseline the user signs as cumulative; refuse if any imported number already exists on the submission, or if the application number differs from the program's recorded number (reuse the APPLICATION_NUMBER_MISMATCH rule from d5176f241). Then insert ectd_sequences rows (dispatch_status 'acknowledged', status as filed) and ectd_compilations rows (compilation_type 'imported', leaf_manifest from step 1). Write a governed sign row and electronic signature binding the Vault content hashes.
3. Record provenance. Add origin TEXT ('platform'|'imported') to ectd_sequences in a new additive migration (ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, appended before the final RLS sweep pair; run ci:migration-set-order and ci:migration-drop-safety). Do not edit unrelated migrations.
4. Package path: in the same act, or a sibling for submission_packages, append FiledSequence entries (package-sequence-lifecycle.ts:57-75) with leafId/backbone, state 'transmitted' and origin 'imported' under withPackageMetadataLock, so planSequence (:430) stops refusing NO_PRIOR_SEQUENCE.
5. Confirm that prior-sequence-loader.ts:138 folds imported rows unchanged (compilation_type 'imported' is not 'rehearsal', and dispatch_status 'acknowledged' qualifies). Confirm that regional-packager.ts:331-370 rebases modified-file to '../<seq>/index.xml#<leafId>' for imported leaves.
6. Add the route POST /api/submissions/:id/filed-sequences/import in server/routes/submissions.ts: editor plus signing authority (same check as the other signing routes), verifyReauth, and the 422/409 refusals from step 2.
7. UI: add an 'Import sequences filed elsewhere' action in client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/SubmissionSeqWorkspaces.tsx on the submission header. It previews the parsed sequences, leaves, checksum results and refusals, and only then asks for the signature. Use honest empty and error states.
8. Tests, failing first. With a 3-sequence FDA fixture (0000-0002) under server/services/ectd/__tests__/fixtures/: import, then assemble 0003 replacing a 0001 leaf, and assert operation='replace' and modified-file='../0001/index.xml#<ID>'. Negative cases: MD5 mismatch, a gap, an application-number mismatch, an unmapped heading and a duplicate sequence each refuse with nothing written. Show the replace test failing at HEAD (it skips with 'declared replace: no filed leaf').
9. Commit on concept2cure-v2 (Rule 0).
records.acceptance: (a) An imported 3-sequence FDA application lets sequence 0003 replace a 0001 leaf. The emitted index.xml carries operation="replace" and a modified-file that resolves to an existing leaf ID in the imported 0001 backbone, and xmllint --valid passes once CAT2-01 lands. (b) The same assertion fails at HEAD. (c) Each refusal case writes nothing: no ectd_sequences, ectd_compilations or signature row. (d) The import is a signed governed act whose signature binds the Vault content hashes, visible in the audit trail. (e) planSequence on a package with imported history no longer returns NO_PRIOR_SEQUENCE.
records.dependencies: CAT2-03 (full ICH heading tree, needed to map imported headings to sections). CAT2-01 (DTDs, to validate imported and new backbones). CAT2-05 for an end-to-end filing. Vault ingest of zip archives.

records.title: eCTD submission-grade gates (DTD, eValidator, regional backbone, xref) are still report-only in production by default, with no boot refusal; PDF/A is now deliberately not required
records.evidenceAtHead: All four gates are opt-in: dtd-bundler.ts:226-228 dtdRequiredFromEnv, regional-backbone-readiness.ts:138-140, cross-reference-resolver.ts:132-134 xrefRequiredFromEnv, and external-validator/config.ts:23-25 evalidatorRequiredFromEnv each return `String(env.X ?? '') === 'true'`, so unset means false. pre-transmit-check.ts:22-25: 'Flag-gated checks are report-only by default'. assess-dispatch-readiness.ts:760-773: 'Default-off ... unless ECTD_REQUIRE_EVALIDATOR is set in production'. `grep -rn ECTD_REQUIRE` over .env.example, docker-compose*.yml, .github/workflows/deploy-aws.yml and infra/ finds no setting. Dockerfile.optimized:58 has a comment only. The boot asserts at server/config/environment.ts:284-345 (RLS, audit seal/chain/export, AI governance) include no eCTD gate posture. scripts/ops/ga-readiness-report.mjs:555-562 only reports the flags. assets/ectd-dtd/ still holds only README.md, a commented checksums.txt and fixtures, so turning the DTD gate on today would block every production assembly. PDF/A: server/services/ectd/pdfa-requirement.ts:1-20 records a founder-delegated decision (2026-10-01) that PDF/A is not required by default, because the agency accepts PDF 1.4-1.7, with deployment and per-org opt-in. That sub-item is a scope decision, not a defect.
records.remaining: ECTD_REQUIRE_DTD, ECTD_REQUIRE_EVALIDATOR, ECTD_REQUIRE_REGIONAL_BACKBONE and ECTD_REQUIRE_XREF still default to report-only in production. No boot or deploy-preflight refusal exists, and no explicit risk-acceptance flag is required. The UI never shows dtdStatus or regionConformant on an assembled package. PDF/A is excluded from the inversion by founder decision.
records.severityRationale: On its own this does not make the pilot unsafe to start. Nothing can reach FDA today (CAT2-05), staging never blocks, and the bundle's own dtdStatus/regionalBackbone records are honest. It must flip in the same release that makes FDA transmission real, though; otherwise a package never DTD- or validator-checked goes to FDA with a 'cleared' dispatch verdict. Treat it as a release blocker for the first production transmit. It cannot flip before CAT2-01 without blocking every production assembly.
records.humanTestingNote: Not observable as a failure. On staging and local, the gates never block (production-only), so testers will see packages assemble and dispatch-readiness clear with no DTD or agency-validator verdict. The assemble toast (GatewayTransmittals.tsx:736) mentions 'conformance opt-ins' but no surface shows whether the package is DTD self-contained or regionally conformant. Testers must not read 'assembled' or 'dispatch cleared' as 'agency-valid'.
records.instructions:
1. Add server/startup/ectd-gate-posture.ts with readEctdGate(name, env) for DTD, EVALIDATOR, REGIONAL_BACKBONE and XREF. Outside production, the current behaviour is kept (unset = report-only). In production: unset or 'true' means required.
